reviewed_modules.rationale: Package layout, signing, provenance, and smoke verification share one release contract.
Download, archive validation, provenance, and atomic publication form one fail-closed transaction.
The page owns top-level stage orchestration; separable panels remain lazy components.
Review preflight, execution, and reconciliation share one snapshot contract.

The service coordinates one verified sorting transaction; transfer, duplicate, conversion, repair, and persistence implementations already live behind injected services. Splitting the transaction coordinator would duplicate rollback and outcome state.
